tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Chop red. The seal and the one primary action per view. Text in red only on paper (4.7:1) and only at 19px bold or larger on paper-2 (4.3:1). Never for errors.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of red fills. Red text on sky bands (6.0:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Process blue, the pop. Large type, shapes and the focus ring only: 3.6:1 on paper, 3.2:1 on sky, 4.1:1 on studio.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Blue that carries text or sits under white (5.5:1). The OK notice border and its check mark.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm paper. The art platform's ground, and text on ink, red and studio.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Raised paper: the fingerprint box, a loaded tile's ground, quiet hovers.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Pale blue bands between sections, the certificate head, problem notices. Ink text on it (14:1).

tokens.name: sky-2
tokens.usage: A wall tile's ground while its image loads.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text on paper (15.8:1), 2px control borders, the footer ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper (8.9:1), paper-2 and sky.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Hints and fine print on paper (5.4:1) and paper-2 (4.95:1); the input border, so a field's edge is findable.

tokens.name: studio
tokens.usage: Warm charcoal, never pure black. The security studio's ground and the artwork backdrop in the certificate viewer.

tokens.name: studio-2
tokens.usage: Raised panels on studio. Red marks on it reach only 2.7:1: put the seal on studio, not studio-2.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page ground for the current theme.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: One step up from surface: boxes and panels that sit on the page.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and 2px borders on surface and surface-raised (15.8:1 paper, 14.8:1 studio).

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-raised (8.9:1 paper, 9.8:1 studio). Studio value is paper at 80% on studio, as the footer sets it.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Hints, fine print and control edges on surface (5.4:1 paper, 7.9:1 studio). Studio value is paper at 70% on studio.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and under the header. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers in labels and the empty-state seal. Decorative only (1.75:1 on paper).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The primary button and selected chips. Paper text on it (4.7:1) in both themes.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px focus outline, offset 3px. At least 3:1 on paper, sky, studio and studio-2.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, the hero line. Fluid: clamp(2.6rem, 1rem + 6.4vw, 6.4rem). Put the second half in an em: it turns red.

styles.name: work-title
styles.usage: A work's title in the certificate viewer. Fluid: clamp(1.8rem, 1rem + 2.4vw, 2.8rem).

styles.name: brand-word
styles.usage: The name beside the seal in the header and footer. Nowhere else.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles under wall tiles and inside the certificate head.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Seal a finished piece and anyone can check which account sealed that exact file, and when.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display line, in text-soft, max 46ch. Fluid: clamp(1.05rem, 0.95rem + 0.45vw, 1.3rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A seal is a receipt, not a judgement.

styles.name: fine-print
styles.sample: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 6 MB.
styles.usage: Hints and fine print, in text-faint.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Section eyebrows; a red index number before a 1px line-strong divider.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Uppercase. Header and footer links, the header call to action, counts.

styles.name: record-key
styles.usage: Uppercase. Keys in the certificate and fingerprint box.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Fingerprints, signatures and key IDs only. Wrap anywhere.

tokens.name: space-chips
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-actions
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in an action row.

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Gap between fields and blocks in a form or panel.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at its widest. Fluid: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 5rem).

tokens.name: space-gutter-min
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: size-max
tokens.usage: Content max width (.wrap).

tokens.name: size-head
tokens.usage: Header height; sticky bars sit under it.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button min height.

tokens.name: size-input
tokens.usage: Text input min height.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Chip min height.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs and notices.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Wall tiles, the certificate, the fingerprint box.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The art preview frame and sealing stage.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: The certificate viewer dialog.

tokens.name: radius-drop
tokens.usage: The drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the search field, the header call to action.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A wall tile on hover, with a 4px lift and a -0.4deg turn.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The paper frame around a piece being sealed.

tokens.name: shadow-field-focus
tokens.usage: A focused text input, with its border going to text.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Borders on buttons, chips, inputs, notices and the certificate.

tokens.name: stroke-drop
tokens.usage: The dashed drop zone edge.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline, offset 3px.
